_about: Haanji's design tokens (stage 13, D088). Roles, not colours: replica-brand may change values, never names. apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts mirrors this file (a test keeps them equal). Check every change: python3 .claude/skills/replica-design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json

font.sans: the platform's system font (San Francisco, Roboto, Segoe UI): no font files to license or download
font._interchange: Stage 20 (D101, D105): Anek by Ek Type (OFL-1.1), self-hosted. The app loads one static file per voice (assets/fonts), registered under these family names; the weight is in the file.

focus._note: The ring is drawn outside the control (offset 2) over bg or surface, so those are its adjacent colours (WCAG 1.4.11); never over the accent.

motion._note: Stage 19 (D098). Milliseconds; easing as cubic-bezier points, never linear. fast and base are interface feedback, hero is the first-impression moments (the welcome rings, a match), sway is the back-and-forth of the landing page's shoreline, loop is one cycle of a gentle ambient movement (it stops within 5 seconds, or has a pause control: WCAG 2.2.2). rise is how far things move up as they appear (points); stagger is the gap between list items. Every animation follows the reduce-motion setting (components.md).

overlay._note: Stage 19 (D099): the dark layer over the welcome screen's video, the overlay colour at this opacity. Text on it is on-accent (white); the keyboard focus ring is highlight. overlay-floor is the brightest it can get (this opacity over a white pixel, the candle flames), so the checked pairs hold anywhere on the video.

scrim._note: Stage 20e: the layer behind a bottom sheet, the sign's graphite at this opacity. It only dims the page behind; nothing is read on it, so it has no pairs.
